newsitem.title: USA: Ambassador Apartments buys Fla. property.
newsitem.headline: Ambassador Apartments buys Fla. property.

text.p: Ambassador Apartments Inc said Thursday it purchased Sun Lake Apartments in northern Orlando, Fla., for $24 million from an affiliate of Balcor Co.
The purchase increases the company's portfolio to 49 properties, containing 14,564 apartments, of which 2,414 are in Florida.

Ambassador Apartments also said it has funding of $14.6 million of newly allocated tax exempt bonds secured by a first mortgage on the 708 unit Mills Apartments in Houston, Texas. The 30-year bonds were issued by Harris County Housing Finance Corp and are credit enhanced for 30 years by Fannie Mae.
Proceeds will be used to pay down the company's line of credit and for future acquisitions.
Ambassador is a real estate investment trust.
